# VivaClean

> VivaClean is a house cleaning company in Austin, Texas. Services: standard cleaning, deep cleaning, move-in and move-out cleaning, recurring cleaning, apartment cleaning, Airbnb turnover cleaning, office cleaning, and post-construction cleaning (quote only). Prices are published and exact online before booking: $129 plus $25 per bedroom, $25 per bathroom, and $8 per 100 square feet. A two-bedroom, two-bathroom, 1,200 square foot home is $325 as a standard clean, $488 as a deep clean, and $569 as a move clean. Recurring plans take 20% off weekly, 15% off every two weeks, and 10% off monthly, starting on the second visit. Every clean ends with timestamped before and after photos of every room in the client portal. If something is missed, flag it within 48 hours and we come back and re-clean it at no charge. Bonded and insured, background-checked cleaners, all supplies included.

Hours: 8 AM to 8 PM daily. Phone: (512) 661-7297. Email: support@getvivaclean.com. Book online: https://app.getvivaclean.com/book
